mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (below 5%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, leads to decreased S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expected earnings downgrades.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating a surge in housing demand, S&P 500 forward returns increase over the next 60 trading days due to expected spillover into related sectors.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with HOUST above its 6mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (below 0.5%) and rising CPIAUCSL (above 2% YoY) creates an inflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of inflationary environment instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in UNRATE (above 0.5% in one month) signals labor market stress, leading to decreased S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in stress periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between high RSAFS (above $400B) and low GDPC1 growth (below 2% YoY) indicates a demand-driven slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of demand-driven slowdown instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
